response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio, AVG(cnt) AS avg_line_item_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 THEN ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS cnt FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id)
